title: The Whispering Promise
summary: Healing grants the recipient +1d4 to attack rolls and saves for 2 turns.

fields.Blessed Mercy: Healing yourself or another creature adds 1d4 to its attack rolls and saves for 2 turns without Concentration, even at full HP. Multi-target and thrown potion healing can affect each recipient. Self-heals from gear and Short Rests qualify. Temporary HP and Blessed Healer do not. The effect neither stacks with standard Bless nor gains the Staff of Arcane Blessing enhancement.
fields.Acquisition: Trade with Volo using the trade button, or obtain the same ring from Grat during Volo’s captivity if you have not acquired it. After rescue, Volo can sell it at camp.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
